QUOTE: `retryFailedPost` in `post.ts:228` runs when the user taps the failed post (its caller is `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says no automatic retries occur and that retrying happens via `retryFailedPost` when the user taps the failed post. It doesn't use the "Try Again" label, but the user-initiated mechanism and the function are both stated.
